a: The unit an AI model reads and writes, about four letters of English
The low end of the band
n: A token is the piece a model actually reads: a short chunk of text, about four letters of English, so a page is roughly 500 of them. Every model has a limit on how many it can hold at once, and every call is priced by the count. When a long document starts getting flat answers, the count is the first thing to check.
